elsewhere.note: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass…
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass…
